name: Bar
lead: A boss bar, from `ui.bossbar` for the room or `player.ui.bossbar` for one player; title, progress and colour are live.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Reads back the words; takes any text.

fields.name: progress
fields.description: How full the bar is, 0 to 1; live.

fields.name: color
fields.description: The bar's colour, from its own closed set; anything else is white. Live.

fields.name: visible
fields.description: Whether players see the bar; false takes it off their screens, true or nil shows it again.

title: Bar type
